about: Scenario A of the live eval: an invented interview, said by TTS into the STT sessions. Each turn says what Live Answer should do. expect.answer: yes = one answer shown; no = nothing shown (the question gate, or the speaker gate, keeps it out); any = whatever, but no error. mentionsAny: the answer names at least one of these (accent- and case-insensitive; '/re/' is a regex). text as a list is said in parts, pauseMs apart. No personal or career data here: this file is in a public repo.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Oi, tudo bem? Obrigado por vir hoje. Vamos começar daqui a pouco.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Nosso time cuida da plataforma de pagamentos e processa alguns milhões de transações por dia.
turns.note: declarative monologue: the gate should skip it

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Como você garantiria que um pagamento não seja cobrado duas vezes quando o cliente clica no botão de novo?

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Posso perguntar como vocês fazem deploy hoje?
turns.note: the candidate's own question: the speaker gate keeps it out

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Me explica a diferença entre consistência forte e consistência eventual.
turns.note: a request with no question mark: the gate's cues are English, so this checks the Portuguese path

turns.speaker: them
text: Pensando nessa plataforma de pagamentos com picos enormes na Black Friday.
Como você escalaria o banco de dados?
turns.note: context first, the question after a pause longer than the STT turn debounce: two them turns, one answer

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: E se uma das réplicas ficar atrasada?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Me fala sobre uma vez em que você discordou de uma decisão técnica do seu time.
turns.note: statement-form behavioral prompt: needs the career cue (or STT punctuation) to pass the gate

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Como você usa o Claude Code no dia a dia?
turns.note: an STT keyterm (future-work item 15): sttTerms are checked in the transcript

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Qual a diferença entre um unbuffered channel e um buffered channel em Go?
turns.note: English terms said in a Portuguese sentence (item 15)

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Depois desta conversa vem a etapa técnica e a gente te manda o retorno até sexta, está bem?
turns.note: tells and ends only checking: one short sentence back, not a recap (spec 2026-10-16-confirmation-check-answer)

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Let's switch to English for this next part, if that's fine with you.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: What's the difference between a process and a thread?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Walk me through what happens when you type a URL in the browser and press enter.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: We have about forty engineers split across four product teams in two time zones.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Can I ask how on-call works on your team?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: How would you design a rate limiter for a public API?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: And how would that work across several regions?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: What do you do when an API token expires in the middle of a job?
turns.note: STT keyterms (future-work item 15): sttTerms are checked in the transcript

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: How would you stay under the rate limits of a partner API? Would you write your own rate limiter?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: What goes into your CLAUDE.md, and how do you use Claude Code day to day?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: When would you pick an unbuffered channel over a buffered channel?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: How do you take advantage of AI to build things faster?
turns.note: "AI" alone, which a real session heard as "a yard"; the keyterm list has it only inside phrases

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Which AI tools are part of your setup?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: After this call you'll meet the hiring manager, and we'll send you feedback by Friday, okay?
turns.note: the same check in English: the one sentence back must be in English, not the rule's Portuguese example (FR-004)

questions: Actually, what is a binary search tree?
Sorry, let me rephrase: when would you use a heap?
Or rather, what is a trie used for?
Final one: what is the time complexity of quicksort?

filler.about: Turns for the long-session stress test: statements only, so the answer lane stays quiet and only the turn count grows.
them: We started the platform about five years ago.
Most of the traffic comes from mobile clients.
The team moved to Kubernetes last year.
We still run a few legacy batch jobs at night.
Our biggest customers are in retail.
me: I worked with a similar setup before.
